conclusions: Original measurement rows and normalized per-observation ionosphere priors are captured before group elimination, including observations with no group parameter.
Independent epoch clock constraints and global pulse/OU/bias constraints enter separate prior rows exactly once.
Both native observation accumulation modes collect the same original objective before reduced QR rows are assembled.
Forked trials retain reference ledgers, reset only current ledgers, and require unchanged observation keys, row counts, support and accepted parent objective replay.
When QR is disabled the new capture hook is inactive; calls outside active collection are guarded by empty stem or finished state.
limitations: Read-only static source/caller audit only; no native numerical validation or new fit was run.

Conclusion is limited to the supported serial, fixed-weight, independent-epoch nuisance pipeline. Correlated observation noise and unsupported normal-matrix constraints are rejected rather than audited as supported.
Raw prior vectors rely on deterministic native parameter/constraint traversal and fixed configuration; this review does not establish correctness for arbitrary custom extensions.
The full source inventory identity is inherited from the immutable successful-build receipt; the listed installed callers and selected candidate extension files were rehashed, not all source files.
This audit does not certify numerical stationarity, the objective directional gate, or a successful scientific benchmark.
